productBoundary: GitNext does not determine that a pull request can be merged or is ready to merge. It provides conservative next-step advice from visible GitHub facts.

verdicts.AUTHOR_ACTION_REQUIRED: Visible evidence identifies an author-side next action; it does not assign fault.
verdicts.SYNC_OR_FIX_BRANCH: GitHub explicitly reports a branch conflict that needs synchronization or resolution.
verdicts.WAIT: The next visible action belongs elsewhere or no known author blocker is present; this is not merge readiness.
verdicts.DONE_OR_STOP: The tracked work is complete, closed, duplicated, or belongs to an inactive repository.
verdicts.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: Visible facts do not justify a stronger conclusion.

responsibleParties.AUTHOR: The pull request or issue author is the next responsible party.
responsibleParties.MAINTAINER: A repository maintainer is the next responsible party.
responsibleParties.REVIEWER: A reviewer is the next responsible party.
responsibleParties.CI: Automated checks are still the next dependency.
responsibleParties.ASSIGNEE_OR_CONTRIBUTOR: An explicitly linked assignee or contributor workflow is pending.
responsibleParties.NONE: No further action is recommended for this item.
responsibleParties.UNKNOWN: The available facts do not identify a responsible party.

availabilityStates.AVAILABLE: The source was collected completely within the contract's bound.
availabilityStates.NOT_APPLICABLE: The source does not apply to this item kind and is not a limitation.
availabilityStates.UNAVAILABLE: The source could not be collected or validated.
availabilityStates.RATE_LIMITED: The source was unavailable because of an API rate limit.
availabilityStates.FORBIDDEN: The source was unavailable because access was forbidden.
availabilityStates.TRUNCATED: The source was collected only to the explicit bounded limit.
